canonical.title: A Léa Linster weekend in Frisange

sources.title: Louis Linster — réservation & contact
sources.claim: Reservation contact +352 23 66 84 11 for the two-star tasting in Frisange.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Léa Linster, Frisange
sources.claim: Two-star tasting menu at 17 route de Luxembourg, Frisange.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Mondorf-les-Bains → Frisange
sources.claim: Last bus from Frisange to Mondorf runs before the tasting menu ends.

sources.title: Webtaxi — fares
sources.claim: Webtaxi €3 base + €4.30/km, +10% after 22:00; a 20 km ride lands near €90.

sources.title: Hôtel de la Frontière
sources.claim: 18 rooms ~1.1 km south of Linster on the N3, bookable only by phone +352 23 61 51.

sources.title: Booking.com — De la Frontière (dormant)
sources.claim: The Booking.com listing is dormant; the in-house restaurant has closed.

sources.title: Airbnb — Évrange / Border Lodge
sources.claim: Border Lodge apartment 1.8 km away across the French border in Évrange.

sources.title: Mondorf Parc Hôtel & Spa
sources.claim: 5 km from Linster; 36 °C thermal pools active since 1847.

sources.title: Hôtel Château Schengen
sources.claim: 17 km from Linster; a 1390 castle where Victor Hugo slept in 1871.

sources.title: Le Place d'Armes
sources.claim: 21 km from Linster; only Relais & Châteaux in the country with an on-site 1-star.

sources.title: Victor's Schloss Berg, Nennig
sources.claim: 20 km across the Moselle bridge; Christian Bau's three Michelin stars since 2005.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Schloss Berg / Bau
sources.claim: Schloss Berg Nennig — guest reviews of Christian Bau's three-star restaurant on site.

sources.title: Mondorf — access & spa rates
sources.claim: 3-hour thermal pass at Mondorf priced €43.50.

sources.title: Les Plus Beaux Villages — Rodemack
sources.claim: Rodemack listed among Les Plus Beaux Villages de France, 8 km over the border.

sources.title: Visit Schengen — European Museum
sources.claim: European Museum at Schengen reopened June 2025 after a full renovation.

sources.title: Princesse Marie-Astrid — schedule
sources.claim: Sunday-lunch cruise on the Princesse Marie-Astrid, 19 Apr – 20 Sep 2026.

sources.title: Luxembourg City — Bock Casemates
sources.claim: Bock Casemates and the Corniche walk before the train back to the airport.

sources.title: Visit Luxembourg — Belval blast furnace
sources.claim: Industrial-heritage day at the Belval blast furnace platform.

sources.title: Musée National des Mines, Rumelange
sources.claim: Underground tour of the Rumelange iron-ore mine in the Minett Biosphere.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Frisange → Echternach
sources.claim: Echternach sits 45.7 km out — beyond the 30 km circle.
